book.name: Matiu
book.title: Yisasife huno Kanale Kea Matiu Kae-malenea Ke.

content: Kanale haviꞋyaꞋami hanea vayaꞋmoꞋya Yisasina agegahe emainae.

HelotiꞋa Yutia kotega ala sauve kano mainea kanafina Yisasina Petelehemu osi Yutia kumate atene. AtetegeꞋya haenagaꞋa yage vaꞋyi nehilegati kanale haviꞋyaꞋami hanea vayaꞋmoꞋya Yelusalemu evaꞋyi hu-mainae.

EvaꞋyi huteꞋya mage huꞋya hae “Menima atea nafaꞋnea, Yuta* vayaꞋmogami sauve kanoa, hanate atene? Nagola haegafa kaꞋnefila yagema evaꞋyi nehilegati evaꞋyi higeta ageteta ‘Ago atene.’ huta agai agi alisaga hugahe neꞋone.” huꞋya hae.
Hageno sauve kanoa HelotiꞋene mukiꞋa Yelusalemu mainaya veaꞋnene ani kea haviteꞋya atali talu hu-mainae.

Atali talu hageno HelotiꞋa mukiꞋa mono note kava vayafeꞋene kahegi kema havilinaya anagafeꞋene ke higeꞋya agaite ageno mage huno hama-vige “Anumaya KotiꞋma taugafa ali-gatigahema hu-tesia kanoa hana kumate ategahie?” huno hama-vi-ge-maine.
Hama-vi-gegeꞋya mage huꞋya hae “Ani nafaꞋnea Petelehemu ategahie. Nayona Anumaya Koti aune kanomoꞋa mage huno kae-maleneane

content.text: ‘Kagaya Petelehemu kumaꞋmoga Yutia kotega mainananagi Yutia kumaꞋyaga ago amakaseka hai-mainananagino kagaipiti ala kava kanoa falote huteno nagai veala Isaleli* veate kava yakaigahie.’ huno kae-maleneane.” huꞋya hae.

content: Hageno HelotiꞋa yage vaꞋyi nehilegati emainaya kanale haviꞋyaꞋami hanea vayaꞋyagahena kesi huno ke higeꞋya ageno “Ani haegafa kaꞋnefila na yu falote hu-maine?” huno hama-vige.
Hama-vigeteno Petelehemu hu-ma-tegahe mage huno hie “Utama ani nafaꞋnehena ati-yetama age-faloteꞋma hinutamahena etetama me naha-paigeꞋna nagaiꞋenena aniꞋa huꞋna agia molisaga hano.” huno hu-maine.
HigeꞋya sauve kanomo kea haviteꞋya mogayana yagema vaꞋyi nehilegati age-mainaya kaꞋnefimoꞋa uhagote-ma-teno viaꞋyamo ani nafaꞋnema mainea nomo amupale umaineno amave-li-maine.
Amave-ligeꞋya ageteꞋya amaipamoꞋa kanale higeꞋya tusiꞋa muse hu-mainae.

Muse hu-teteꞋya ani nopi hai-faleꞋya agayana ani nafaꞋnegi itaꞋamoꞋa MaliaꞋagi huꞋana mainaꞋageꞋya mogeteꞋya mopafi mope huꞋya agia alisaga nehuꞋya kuꞋamifiti muse yana amigahe monegi manaꞋage taꞋnefagi kule fuki kana huno manaꞋage mea tinagi huꞋya aminae.
AmiteꞋya himona agayana Anumaya KotiꞋa himonafi mage huno hama-paiye “Heloti mainesilega etetama oꞋviho” huno higeꞋya alu kate uteꞋya kumaꞋamilega umainae.
YosefeꞋa MaliaꞋene nafaꞋnene anavaleno Isipi kotega umaine.

Kanale haviꞋyaꞋami hanea vayala utageno YosefeꞋa Anumayamo ensole kanoa himonafi agegeno mage huno hie “Hetika nafaꞋnene itaꞋamoꞋene Isipi kotega tamaiya-yetama viho. Anilega umainegeꞋna nagayama eteꞋna hisugetama etetama egahae. HelotiꞋa kagai nafaꞋnehe ati-yeno haesia ke nehie.” huno hie.
Higeno YosefeꞋa ani himona ageteno aupaꞋa hetino nafaꞋnene itaꞋamoꞋene ani kegela anavaleno Isipi kotega ugahe umainae.
Ani kotega ayaꞋaya kanagefa umainageno HelotiꞋa falitegeꞋya neꞋataleꞋya emainae. Ani yafena nayona AnumayamoꞋa aune kanomo avayafiti mage huno hu-maineane

content.text: “Isipi kotegati nagaiꞋni nafaꞋnea ke hisugeno egahie” huno hu-maineane.

content: Nayoma hu-mainea kemoꞋa ani yupa ago efalote huno tamage hu-maine.
HelotiꞋa higeꞋya kasagoꞋya nafaꞋneyaga hamayageꞋya fali-mainae.

HelotiꞋa agesa havitenoꞋe “Ani kanale haviꞋyaꞋami hanea vayaꞋmoꞋya aye-navataga hae.” huno tusiꞋa ke vai-maine. Kanale haviꞋyaꞋami hanea vayaꞋmogami kea haviteno “YisasiꞋa ani augafa kafuꞋa hane.” huno nagoꞋa vayala hu-ma-tegeꞋya Petelehemu kumateꞋene atupa kumaꞋyagaleꞋene mukiꞋama yaufa tole (2) kafua ohunaya neꞋnafaꞋneyaga “HamaegeꞋya faliho.” huno hu-ma-tene.
YelemaiyaꞋa nayona Anumaya Koti aune kanomoꞋa mage huno hu-maineane

content.text: “Lama kumategati mukiꞋa veaꞋmoꞋya ala kefiti ke huꞋya hamau huꞋya avi-taya kea vayaꞋmoꞋya havimainae. Leselina aginagomogami nafaꞋneyagahe tusiꞋa avi-tegeꞋya nafaꞋneyagaꞋama faliya yafe veaꞋmoꞋya aipa ali falu hutayanagi tusi avi-te-maine.” huno hu-maineane.

content: Ani yupa nayoma hu-mainea kemoꞋa ago efalote huno tamage hie.
YosefeꞋene MaliaꞋene nafaꞋneꞋaene eteꞋya Nasaleti emainae.
HelotiꞋa falitegeno YosefeꞋa Isipi kotega maineno himonafi Anumayamo ensole kanomona agegeno mage huno hapaiye.
“Hetika nafaꞋnene itaꞋamoꞋene neꞋanavaleka Isaleli kotega viho. Kagai nafaꞋnema haesaya amakesa haviya vayala ago faliye.” huno hie.
Higeno YosefeꞋa hetino nafaꞋnene itaꞋamoꞋene neꞋanavaleno Isaleli kotega umainae.

Umainagi “HelotiꞋa ago falitegeno agaiꞋa nafaꞋnemoꞋa AkelausiꞋa Yutia kotega kava hu-maine.” huꞋya haya kea YosefeꞋa haviteno koli huno “Anilega oꞋugahue.” huteno himonafina “Anilega oꞋviho.” huno hia kea haviteno Kalili umaine.
Kalili viana osi kumala Nasaleti uno maine. Nayona Anumaya Koti amaune vayaꞋmoꞋya Yisasifena mage huꞋya hu-mainayane

content.text: “Agaya Nasaleti kano maine.” huꞋya hugahae huꞋya hu-mainayane

content: Ani yupa nayoma hu-mainaya kemoꞋa ago efalote huno tamage hu-maine.
